item.title: シリアのクルド系民兵組織、解散発表 軍と統合の一環
item.description: [ダマスカス ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ダマスカス ２５日 ロイター] - シリアのクルド人勢力主体の民兵組織「シリア民主軍（ＳＤＦ）」が２５日、解散を発表した。暫定政権と今年合意した部隊統合計画における大きな一歩となる。

ＳＤＦのアブディ司令官はテレビ演説で「われわれは本日、シリア民主軍の任務終了を発表し、独立した軍事組織としての解散を全責任をもって宣言する」と述べた。

暫定政権とＳＤＦは今年１月、クルド人戦闘員をシリア軍に段階的に統合することで合意していた。ＳＤＦは米国の支援を受けて過激派組織「イスラム国」（ＩＳ）掃討に貢献し、シリア北部と東部の一部を実効支配していた。

アブディ氏は今回の発表について、シャラア暫定大統領との合意に基づき、シリア軍への部隊統合が完了したことを受けたものだと述べた。

暫定政権は米政府の支援を受けながら、国内対立の解消とシリア再建を進めている。

item.title: After surrendering lead in 9th, Mets edge Brewers in 10th
item.description: Francisco Lindor homered and later scoring the winning run in the 10th inning as the host New York Mets beat the Milwaukee Brewers 3-2 in the opener of a three-game series Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Francisco Lindor homered and later scoring the winning run in the 10th inning as the host New York Mets beat the Milwaukee Brewers 3-2 in the opener of a three-game series Tuesday. Bo Bichette flew out to lead off the 10th against Trevor Megill (2-3), who then walked Carson Benge and Luis Robert Jr. Lindor, who opened the 10th as the automatic runner, broke for home on Christopher Morel's grounder to third. David Hamilton's throw beat Lindor but sailed to the first base side of the plate. Jonathan Pintaro (2-0) walked one in a scoreless top of the 10th to get the win. Robert homered and had two hits for the Mets, who are 13-8 this month. Benge finished with three hits while Lindor added two hits. Luis Lara hit a run-scoring single in the fourth and Christian Yelich delivered the game-tying, pinch-hit RBI double in the ninth for the Brewers, who have dropped two straight following a 6-1 stretch. William Contreras had three hits and scored both runs for Milwaukee. He opened the ninth with a double off Austin Warren before Jake Bauers walked ahead of Yelich. The Brewers' comeback cost Mets rookie Zac Thornton a win following another solid start. Thornton gave up one run on seven hits and no walks while striking out four. He is 3-3 with a 2.35 ERA in eight starts since his most recent recall from Triple-A Syracuse on July 12. Kyle Harrison allowed one run on six hits and one walk while striking out five over five innings for the Brewers. The southpaw wriggled out of a bases-loaded jam in the first, when he gave up three straight one-out singles before striking out Eric Wagaman and getting Jared Young to ground out. The teams combined for seven hits -- all singles -- but stranded seven runners in the first three innings before the Brewers snapped the scoreless tie. Contreras led off the fourth with a double and raced home on Lara's two-out single to left. Harrison retired six straight before Lindor homered to left-center with one out in the fifth. Robert gave the Mets the lead in the sixth with a leadoff homer against Chad Patrick. New York's Nate Lavender retired all six batters he faced before the Brewers mounted their rally against Warren. --Field Level Media

item.title: China prepares for more heavy rain from back-to-back storms
item.description: China's coastal areas and southern regions are preparing for days of intense precipitation, with tens of thousands of people evacuated as Typhoon Narra tracks inland and another storm churns toward the country's eastern seaboard.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's coastal areas and southern regions are preparing for days of intense precipitation, with tens of thousands of people evacuated as Typhoon Narra tracks inland and another storm churns toward the country's eastern seaboard. [USN:L1N44M010 TEXT:"Narra"] made landfall as a tropical storm on Tuesday evening in the southern island province of Hainan after lingering over the Beibu Gulf — also known as the Gulf of Tonkin — for several days, dumping heavy rain across Guangxi, Hainan and Guangdong. Narra and the accompanying Typhoon Saudel, alongside tropical cyclones Gaenari and Atsani, form a rare quartet of storms swirling simultaneously across the Northwest Pacific and South China Sea, according to China's Meteorological Administration. The multi-storm system has forced regional authorities including in Guangxi and Hainan to close businesses, suspend tourist operations and evacuate tens of thousands of residents. Heavy rain is expected to persist in the south, even as recent downpours have already pushed rivers over warning levels and inundated low-lying areas in Guangxi. Typhoon Saudel is forecast to make landfall along China's eastern seaboard between Zhejiang and Fujian provinces between Thursday and Friday, with weather models projecting its outer rain bands could extend back toward Guangxi. Saudel swept across Japan's Okinawa prefecture early on Wednesday, prompting weather agencies to issue warnings for destructive winds and high seas. As the storm moved west, it brought the Amami island chain in Kagoshima Prefecture into its storm-force wind radius, leaving nearly 35,000 homes without power, according to Kyushu Electric. A total of 92 flights serving airports across Okinawa Prefecture were canceled on Wednesday, while All Nippon Airways suspended all flights to and from Naha Airport, the prefecture's main gateway, public broadcaster NHK reported. Taiwan's Central Weather Administration said Saudel is tracking north of the island, where it is expected to gradually weaken and shrink in storm radius, bringing moderate rainfall to parts of northern and southern Taiwan through Friday.

item.title: Salvador Perez, Royals take down Blue Jays for ninth consecutive win
item.description: Salvador Perez knocked in the go-ahead run with a fifth-inning single Tuesday night as the visiting Kansas City Royals defeated the Toronto Blue Jays 5-3 for their ninth straight victory.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Salvador Perez knocked in the go-ahead run with a fifth-inning single Tuesday night as the visiting Kansas City Royals defeated the Toronto Blue Jays 5-3 for their ninth straight victory. Toronto's Brett Bateman had three hits in the opener of the three-game series. The Blue Jays have dropped three of their past four. Kansas City starter Seth Lugo (6-7) allowed one run on six hits and one walk with five strikeouts in five innings. The game ended when Toronto's Nathan Lukes was thrown out at second trying to stretch his two-run single off Steven Cruz. Left fielder Isaac Collins got the ball to shortstop Bobby Witt Jr., whose throw to second got Lukes. The Royals scored once in the first against Max Scherzer (1-7) when Perez grounded into a double play with the bases loaded. The inning started with Carter Jensen hitting a single and Witt and Vinnie Pasquantino drawing walks. Toronto tied the game in the bottom of the inning on Jesus Sanchez's sacrifice fly. Bateman and Lukes singled to start the inning before Kazuma Okamoto walked with one out. The Royals took a 2-1 lead in the fifth. Jensen walked with one out and was forced at second on Witt's grounder to shortstop. Pasquantino's single put runners at the corners for Perez, who delivered an RBI base hit to left. Scherzer allowed two runs on four hits and five walks with four strikeouts in five innings. Royals second baseman Michael Massey left the game in the fifth inning after falling and hitting his head on the turf while throwing out Lukes at first on a grounder. The Royals reported that the injury did not appear serious. Kansas City took a 4-1 lead in the sixth. Nick Loftin led off with an infield hit against Braydon Fisher. John Rave's one-out single put runners at the corners. Mason Fluharty replaced Fisher, and a run scored when first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. threw wildly to first on Kyle Isbel's bunt, leaving runners at second and third. Jensen followed with a sacrifice fly to center. Former Blue Jay Nate Pearson pitched around a walk, a double and a hit batter in the eighth. Kansas City added a run in the ninth against Tyler Rogers. Tyler Tolbert, who replaced Massey, singled, stole second and scored on Rave's two-out single. --Field Level Media

item.title: China flexes its auto-safety chops with huge recall of Tesla, other cars
item.description: A huge recall in China last week aims to address a long-standing fear of EV owners: potentially being trapped in their cars when the power fails. It also highlights how Beijing is now spearheading new auto safety standards for some of the world's most advanced cars.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A huge [USN:L1N44I0AY TEXT:"recall"] in China last week aims to address a long-standing fear of EV owners: potentially being trapped in their cars when the power fails. It also highlights how Beijing is now spearheading new auto safety standards for some of the world's most advanced cars. Marking the largest recall to date in the world's biggest car market, nine automakers including Tesla (TSLA.O) , Xiaomi (1810.HK) and Leapmotor (9863.HK) said they would fix a combined 4.3 million vehicles due to concerns that emergency buttons or levers inside cars that allow occupants to manually open a door can be hard to find. The move follows China's announcement in February of a ban on exterior electronic handles without a traditional manual mechanism that opens the door. The ban on such minimalist designs, which were popularised by Tesla and imitated by Chinese EV makers, will apply to new models from next year. Whereas U.S. and European regulators have historically taken the lead in global auto safety, China — now the world's biggest EV market by far with electric vehicles accounting for almost 55% of new cars sold — could soon be setting the tone. "The trend is clear: China is, bit by bit, approaching regulatory leadership for advanced vehicle tech," said Pedro Pacheco, a vice president of research at consultancy firm Gartner. 'ASSERTIVE SAFETY-REGULATION PHASE' While Chinese automakers have rolled out features like fast-charging batteries and advanced self-driving software with breathtaking speed, they have often prioritised user experience and aesthetics over other considerations, analysts said. Now Chinese regulators appear to be moving the industry in a new direction, increasing oversight and introducing rules requiring automakers to track the condition and repair history of all EVs sold. It's a shift "from rapid EV innovation and feature proliferation toward a much more assertive safety-regulation phase," said Bill Russo, CEO of the Shanghai-based advisory firm Automobility. Door-release and door handle issues have also been a concern in the United States and Europe, although authorities have yet to take action. In July, the U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), responding to a petition seeking a defect investigation into the emergency mechanical door release on about 180,000 Tesla (TSLA.O) Model 3 vehicles, said the issue would be more appropriately addressed through an ongoing rule-making process. The NHTSA declined to comment for this article. European regulators, which last year flagged potential risks involving door-handle designs as a key priority, did not respond to Reuters queries. China's State Administration for Market Regulation also did not respond to a request for comment. Michael Brooks, executive director of the Center for Auto Safety, a Washington, D.C.-based advocacy group, said the NHTSA has struggled on fast-moving trends in vehicle technology, like self-driving cars and touchscreen controls, while regulators in China have implemented rules faster. Some safety requirements in the U.S., like rear seat-belt warnings, have taken more than a decade amid bureaucratic delays and industry pushback. "There are so many ways for a regulation to get thwarted, changed, withdrawn by an incoming administration," he said. "These are the kind of delays you would never see in China." Other notable examples of China breaking new ground in auto safety regulation include last year's [USN:L4N3QV07I TEXT:"ban of terms"] such as "smart driving" and "autonomous driving" in advertising driver assistance systems. That's gone further than most Western markets, although California last year found Tesla [USN:L6N3ZE01N TEXT:"violated state law"] with its use of the phrase "autopilot" in its marketing. TRAPPED INSIDE For this latest recall in China, automakers will fix the issue by attaching clearer labels to the door-release mechanisms and deploying over-the-air software updates that will lower windows in an emergency. Door-release and door handle issues have drawn scrutiny globally after cases emerged of people becoming trapped inside burning vehicles. Chinese state media reported in October that the driver of a Xiaomi SU7 sedan died after a crash and fire, and that passersby were not able to open the doors to pull him out. In the U.S., several lawsuits have alleged that Tesla's door-handle designs led to injuries or deaths after drivers or passengers were trapped in a vehicle while it was on fire. Some drivers have complained to the NHTSA about being unable to get their child out of a vehicle after exiting. For Tesla, the Chinese regulatory action could force it to rethink its minimalist door handle design globally, Russo said. "Because China is such an important sales and production market for Tesla, I would expect Tesla to design toward the Chinese requirement rather than maintain a completely separate solution just for China," he said. Tesla did not respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Astros battle past Yankees in back-and-forth affair
item.description: Yainer Diaz homered twice, Yordan Alvarez hit a tiebreaking RBI triple with two outs in the eighth inning Tuesday night and the visiting Houston Astros outlasted the New York Yankees for a 9-7 victory.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Yainer Diaz homered twice, Yordan Alvarez hit a tiebreaking RBI triple with two outs in the eighth inning Tuesday night and the visiting Houston Astros outlasted the New York Yankees for a 9-7 victory. Houston won for just the sixth time in its past 15 games by scoring three runs off Brent Headrick (7-3) in the eighth. Diaz started the rally by lifting Headrick's fastball into the right field seats for a 6-6 tie with one out. After a single by Jeremy Pena, Alvarez roped a first-pitch slider to the warning track in right-center field. After getting his seventh career triple, Alvarez scored what became the game-winning run on a single by Isaac Paredes. Spencer Jones doubled and Jazz Chisholm Jr. singled him home to kick off the bottom of the eighth for the Yankees and make it 8-7, but Bryan Abreu (5-3) got Austin Wells to ground into a double play. Two batters later, Josh Hader struck out Trent Grisham. Hader easily notched the final four outs for his 19th save in 19 chances. Diaz also hit a solo shot in the second inning before adding his third RBI of the night on a ninth-inning single. Houston finished with 14 hits and scored six runs off New York's relievers. Pena homered and Daulton Varsho had a pair of RBI singles for the Astros, who tied the contest three times before taking the lead against Headrick. The Astros needed their rally in the eighth after New York's Luis Garcia Jr. hit an RBI double in the seventh off Steven Okert. Garcia had his third four-hit game this season and eighth of his career. He singled in his first two at-bats before hitting a two-run homer off Houston rookie starter Ethan Pecko to give the Yankees a 5-3 lead in the fifth. Cody Bellinger hit a three-run homer that broke a 32-game drought in the third after the Astros scored the first two runs of the contest. Pecko allowed five runs on five hits in 4 1/3 innings. New York starter Will Warren allowed three runs (two earned) on seven hits in five innings, but the Yankees took their second loss in eight games and remained 3 1/2 games behind Tampa Bay in the AL East. --Field Level Media

item.title: India's Tilaknagar open to another large deal after Imperial Blue buyout, chairman says
item.description: India's Tilaknagar Industries is open to another large deal after its nearly $500 million purchase of the Imperial Blue whisky brand from Pernod Ricard , a top executive said, as consolidation gathers pace in India's liquor market.
item.dc:creator: Praveen Paramasivam
item.content:encoded: India's Tilaknagar Industries (TILK.NS) is open to another large deal after its nearly $500 million purchase of the [USN:S8N3SG08G TEXT:"Imperial Blue"] whisky brand from Pernod Ricard (PERP.PA) , a top executive said, as consolidation gathers pace in India's liquor market. Deals, including United Spirits' (UNSP.NS) purchase of Nao Spirits and Sazerac's stake in John Distilleries, underscore growing investor interest in India's spirits industry as liquor makers seek to broaden portfolios and gain scale. "Definitely we will" consider another deal on that scale if the right opportunity emerges, Chairman and Managing Director Amit Dahanukar said. "Before Imperial Blue, I would have never given a target number which had two times our revenue." The maker of Mansion House brandy is open to any spirits category on acquisitions, Dahanukar said. "From an M&A perspective, we remain focused on the craft spirits space within the high-growth super premium and luxury segments," he added. Dahanukar did not disclose how much the company had set aside for potential deals. He said Tilaknagar would be "disciplined" in financing future acquisitions, citing the mix of debt and equity used for the Imperial Blue purchase. The Imperial Blue acquisition has already transformed Tilaknagar's scale. Revenue nearly tripled to 10.26 billion Indian rupees ($107.46 million) in the first quarter ended June 30, with the whisky brand accounting for nearly two-thirds of total sales volume. Industry fragmentation and state-level regulations make it difficult for liquor makers to build national scale, creating incentives for consolidation, said Devangshu Dutta, founder of retail consultancy Third Eyesight. India is expected to become the world's largest spirits market by volume by 2032, surpassing China as millions of consumers reach legal drinking age each year, according to alcohol industry data provider IWSR. ($1 = 95.4800 Indian rupees)

item.title: Jarren Duran's slam in the 11th carries Red Sox past Marlins
item.description: Jarren Duran slugged a grand slam in the 11th inning as the Boston Red Sox defeated the host Miami Marlins 7-3 on Tuesday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jarren Duran slugged a grand slam in the 11th inning as the Boston Red Sox defeated the host Miami Marlins 7-3 on Tuesday night. Mickey Gasper homered twice for the Red Sox, who have won five straight games. Gasper, waived by the Nationals in January and demoted by the Red Sox to the minors in late May, has five homers in his past eight games. Prior to that, he had no homers in 109 at-bats in the majors this season. Boston, leading 3-2, nearly won the game in the 10th inning. Rookie reliever Wyatt Olds, pitching with two outs and runners on second and third, struck out Javier Sanoja. However, catcher Connor Wong couldn't corral the wild pitch, and Brian Navaretto scored from third. Boston scored in the top of the 10th inning on a cross-up passed ball. The Marlins, who have lost two straight, were led by Heriberto Hernandez, who slugged a solo home run. It was his team-high 20th homer of the season. Neither starter earned a decision. Boston's Payton Tolle struck out seven and allowed two runs in 5 1/3 innings. Miami's Tyler Phillips lasted 4 2/3 innings, allowing one run and tying his career high with seven strikeouts. In fact, Phillips struck out the side in the first inning before allowing Gasper's first homer in the second inning. Phillips didn't throw a bad pitch -- 96 mph at the bottom of the zone -- but Gasper slugged it 394 feet to center. Miami loaded the bases with one out in the fifth as Xavier Edwards doubled, Griffin Conine singled and Esteury Ruiz walked. Navarreto, Miami's third-string catcher, then fouled off six pitches before lofting a sacrifice fly to cap a 10-pitch plate appearance, tying the score 1-1. Both teams scored a run in the sixth as Gasper homered on a 418-foot bomb off reliever Tyler Zuber and Hernandez went deep on a 3-2 cutter from Tolle. That blast was measured at 403 feet. Miami nearly went ahead in the seventh as pinch hitter Jakob Marsee singled and advanced on Navarreto's sacrifice bunt, but was thrown out at home by first baseman Willson Contreras on Otto Lopez's infield single. --Field Level Media

item.title: Raisel Iglesias, Braves hold on to end Dodgers' 6-game win streak
item.description: Ozzie Albies hit a go-ahead RBI single in the eighth inning and Raisel Iglesias pitched around a leadoff triple in the ninth as the Atlanta Braves posted a 4-3 victory over the visiting Los Angeles Dodgers on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Ozzie Albies hit a go-ahead RBI single in the eighth inning and Raisel Iglesias pitched around a leadoff triple in the ninth as the Atlanta Braves posted a 4-3 victory over the visiting Los Angeles Dodgers on Tuesday. Shohei Ohtani began the ninth with a deep drive that bounced off left fielder Lane Thomas' glove, allowing the Los Angeles superstar to reach third. Iglesias then struck out Freddie Freeman and got Mookie Betts to ground out. After Max Muncy was intentionally walked, Tommy Edman flied out to center field, preserving Atlanta's second straight win and Iglesias' 28th save in 31 tries. Braves starter Bryce Elder threw six innings of three-run, eight-hit ball, striking out five and walking none. Dylan Dodd (4-1) had a two-pitch outing, getting the last out of the eighth. Making his first start since May 6, having recovered from lower back spasms, Los Angeles' Tyler Glasnow went five innings and allowed three runs on six hits. He struck out seven and issued no walks as the Dodgers' six-game winning streak ended. Olson began the bottom of the eighth with a double off Tanner Scott (1-4). Dubon's groundout advanced Olson to third, and the runner held when Michael Harris II grounded back to the mound. Albies then lined a single to center, putting Atlanta on top. In the first, Atlanta's Drake Baldwin and Olson singled to put runners on the corners with one out. Mauricio Dubon and Harris then laced consecutive RBI singles, and Albies' sacrifice fly gave the Braves a 3-0 lead. After Muncy and Kyle Tucker singled in the second, Alek Thomas and Hunter Feduccia both had RBI base hits to pull the Dodgers within one. Los Angeles tied the score in the fourth. Edman singled and stole second before scoring on Alex Call's single. The Dodgers threatened in the sixth, as Edman was hit by a pitch and went to third on Call's one-out single. Elder escaped, though, striking out Lane Thomas and Feduccia to finish his start. Los Angeles reliever Evan Phillips entered with runners at first and second and two outs in the seventh, but he got Ronald Acuna Jr. to ground out sharply and keep the game tied. Dodd faced the same challenge in the top of the eighth, and he stranded two runners by getting pinch hitter Miguel Rojas to fly out. --Field Level Media

item.title: トランプ氏、オンタリオ湖を「アメリカ湖」に改称検討 カナダ人や現地観光客の反応は
item.description: トランプ米大統領は25日、北米五大湖の一つであるオンタリオ湖の名称を「アメリカ湖」に変更することを検討していると述べた。米国とカナダの貿易戦争が激化する中、カナダをけん制する発言となる。 トランプ大統領は交流サイト（SNS）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に、「米国はオンタリオ湖の名称を『アメリカ湖』に変更することを真剣に検討している。オンタリオ州ともはや多くのビジネスをするつもりはないからだ」と投稿した。 トランプ氏の発言について問われたカナダのルブラン対米貿易担当相は、CNBCのインタビューで「連邦政府として、大統領や閣僚による日々のソーシャルメディアへの投稿には反応しないことを数カ月前に決定した」と応じた。 一方、オンタリオ州のフォード首相はCNNのインタビューで「大半がレトリックだろう。オンタリオ州は米17州にとって最大の顧客で、さらに他12州にとって第2の顧客だ。オンタリオ州だけでも単独で見れば、世界第3位の貿易相手となるだ
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: トランプ米大統領は25日、北米五大湖の一つであるオンタリオ湖の名称を「アメリカ湖」に変更することを検討していると述べた。米国とカナダの貿易戦争が激化する中、カナダをけん制する発言となる。 トランプ大統領は交流サイト（SNS）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に、「米国はオンタリオ湖の名称を『アメリカ湖』に変更することを真剣に検討している。オンタリオ州ともはや多くのビジネスをするつもりはないからだ」と投稿した。 トランプ氏の発言について問われたカナダのルブラン対米貿易担当相は、CNBCのインタビューで「連邦政府として、大統領や閣僚による日々のソーシャルメディアへの投稿には反応しないことを数カ月前に決定した」と応じた。 一方、オンタリオ州のフォード首相はCNNのインタビューで「大半がレトリックだろう。オンタリオ州は米17州にとって最大の顧客で、さらに他12州にとって第2の顧客だ。オンタリオ州だけでも単独で見れば、世界第3位の貿易相手となるだろう」と語った。 トランプ大統領は過去に、メキシコ湾の名称を「アメリカ湾」に変更する大統領令に署名した経緯がある。 米国は22日、カナダとの通商交渉が決裂したことを受け、約200億ドル相当のカナダ製品に対する50％の追加関税を発動。カナダ政府も25日、米措置と同規模となる276億カナダドル（約199億4000万米ドル）相当の米国製品に関税を課す報復措置を発表した。 カナダのカーニー首相は24日、米国の交渉担当者が、カナダの公用語の一つであるフランス語の表記要件を損なう可能性のある変更案を提示したことで、貿易協定が頓挫したと述べた。 トランプ大統領は、フランス語の使用要件を巡る対立が貿易交渉の決裂の一因となったとの見方を否定。SNSへの投稿で「カナダ人がフランス語を話すことに決して干渉しない」とし、「弱くて無能な首相がケベック州民の政治的支持を得ようとしてでっち上げたものだ」と主張した。 世論調査データによると、人口の80％がフランス語を話すケベック州では、トランプ氏に対する嫌悪感がカナダの他のどの地域よりも高いことが示されている。

item.title: BOJ chief Ueda to skip Jackson Hole, shifts market focus to G20
item.description: Bank of Japan board member Naoki Tamura will attend the U.S. Federal Reserve's annual gathering in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, this week on behalf of Governor Kazuo Ueda, the central bank said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Leika Kihara
item.content:encoded: Bank of Japan board member Naoki Tamura will attend the U.S. Federal Reserve's annual gathering in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, this week on behalf of Governor Kazuo Ueda, the central bank said on Wednesday. Ueda will not attend the conclave this week due to scheduling conflicts, the BOJ said. There will be no media opportunity for Tamura during the meeting, it said. It is rare for a BOJ board member to participate in the Jackson Hole meeting, which is typically attended by the governor or one of the central bank's two deputy governors. A former commercial banker, [USN:L1N42X01J TEXT:"Tamura"] is seen as a hawk on the nine-member board and has publicly called for raising interest rates once every few months to counter upside risks to prices. What new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh might say about the outlook for U.S. monetary policy in his debut speech at Jackson Hole would have huge repercussions for Japan due to swings in the yen and bond yields, analysts say. Ueda's absence at Jackson Hole will put the spotlight on his possible appearance at next week's U.S.-hosted G20 finance leaders' gathering in Asheville, North Carolina. Market participants are on the lookout for hints from BOJ policymakers about whether the central bank could speed up the pace and timing of rate hikes to cope with mounting inflationary risks. While the BOJ has not disclosed whether Ueda will attend the G20 gathering, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent had said he was looking forward to meeting the BOJ chief in Asheville. A joint U.S.-Japan [USN:L1N43Z05E TEXT:"yen intervention"] and a [USN:L1N442032 TEXT:"nudge"] from Bessent has led markets to near fully price in the chance of a September rate hike by the BOJ, which would follow one in June. A majority of economists [USN:L4N44I0F4 TEXT:"polled by Reuters"] expect the BOJ to raise its policy rate to 1.25% from 1% at the September 17 and 18 meeting. BOJ Deputy Governor Ryozo Himino will also deliver a speech and hold a news conference on Thursday, where he could deliver signs about the likelihood of a rate hike next month.

item.title: Three takeaways from Tuesday's South Carolina Republican Senate primary
item.description: South Carolina Republicans on Tuesday nominated Darline Graham to run in November's general election for her late brother's U.S. Senate seat, as she defeated Representative Ralph Norman in a primary runoff.
item.dc:creator: Richard Cowan
item.content:encoded: South Carolina Republicans on Tuesday nominated Darline Graham to run in November's general election for her late brother's U.S. Senate seat, as she defeated Representative Ralph Norman in a primary runoff. Here are some takeaways from [USN:L1N44I0QT TEXT:"the result:"] TRUMP ENDORSEMENT PAID OFF President Donald Trump didn't just endorse Graham – sharing a stage with her in South Carolina on Friday, he declared that he too was "on the ballot." A day before the primary runoff, he appeared to hedge his bets: For "a few" of the candidates he endorsed it was "almost impossible for them to win," he posted on Truth Social, but he felt "obligated" to back them. He did not specify which candidates he was referring to, though the post came amid concerns about the viability of Graham's campaign. By late Tuesday, however, it was clear she had pulled it off. While Norman performed well in his home base of Greenville, Graham outperformed him in much of the rest of the state – including a resounding win in the area surrounding Myrtle Beach, where Trump campaigned with her last week. It was a much-needed win for Trump, facing mounting public concerns over inflation, the conflict with Iran and an escalating [USN:SPN44J009 TEXT:"trade war with Canada"]. Only 33% of Americans approve of his performance, according to the latest Reuters/Ipsos[USN:L6N44L0VD TEXT:" poll,"] but Tuesday's result shows he still has singular influence among Republican voters. The president's ability to boost turnout among his party faithful will be a key factor in determining whether Republicans are able to retain control of the U.S. House of Representatives and Senate in November's midterm elections. MAGA INC. MEGA MONEY A political action committee, MAGA INC., established to support Trump, spent $827,711 to bolster Graham's campaign, according to reports filed with the Federal Election Commission. While Trump has given his vocal endorsement to Republicans in races across the country, his PAC has rarely contributed to their campaigns. It appears to have paid off for Trump, and could embolden MAGA INC. to keep the money flowing to the president's favored candidates in key races going forward. GRAHAM AN UNLIKELY REBEL IN THE SENATE The late Senator Lindsey Graham became a close ally of Trump's after a rocky start in 2016 when, as a candidate in the Republican presidential primaries, he referred to Trump as a "bigot" and "complete idiot." He would go on to become a frequent golfing companion of the president and one of his most loyal supporters in Congress. Darline Graham so far has followed in her brother's footsteps, and would appear to be another ally in the making for Trump. It is still unclear, however, whether Republicans will be able to hold onto their slim Senate majority next year. Whether they do or not, Graham is looking like she could be in the mold of many first-term senators who have held to another tradition, keeping their heads down during their maiden year and following their leadership's desires.

item.title: 米ディックス株が上場来最大の下落、昨年買収のフットロッカー不振
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米スポーツ用品小売り大手ディックス・スポーティング・グッズの株価が上場来最大の下落となった。昨年買収した米シューズ小売りフットロッカーの苦戦が続いていることが明らかになり、スニーカー市場全体への懸念が強まった。

ディックスは今年度の売上高を219億－222億ドル（約3兆4900億－3兆5300億円）と見込み、従来予想から下方修正した。昨年24億ドルで買収したフットロッカーの売上高減少が響いた。

エド・スタック会長はアナリストとの電話会見で「しばらく厳しい状況が続く」と述べた。

同社によると、ブランド各社が自社ウェブサイトで値引きを拡大したことで、5－7月（第2四半期）は靴市場で販促競争が一段と激しくなった。従来型のスニーカーは以前ほど消費者の支持を得ていないという。具体的なブランド名は挙げなかった。一方、ブーツで知られるUGG（アグ）や、サンダルのビルケンシュトックなどに需要が移っているという。

ディックス株は25日、一時31%安となり、2002年の上場以来最大の日中下落率を記録。25日終値までの年初来では、S&P500種株価指数が12%上昇した中、約37%下落した。

業績見通しを引き下げる消費関連企業が相次ぐ中、ディックスもその一社となった。同社の決算を受け、ブランド各社の株価も下落。米スポーツ用品大手ナイキは一時4.2%安となった。S&Pコンポジット1500繊維・アパレル・ぜいたく品株指数も下落し、米スポーツウエアのルルレモン・アスレティカや米靴メーカーのデッカーズ・アウトドアなどが下げをけん引した。

ブルームバーグ・インテリジェンス（BI）のシニアアナリスト、リンゼー・ダッチ氏はリポートで、今回の決算と業績見通しの引き下げにより、フットロッカー買収の妥当性を巡る懐疑的な見方が一段と強まったと指摘した。

25年5月にフットロッカー買収が発表された際には、経営難に陥っていた同社を傘下に収めることで、不振が続くショッピングモールの影響を一段と受けることになるとして、一部アナリストから批判が出ていた。

item.title: Indian shares open higher as oil slides on Strait of Hormuz reopening hopes
item.description: Indian shares opened marginally higher on Wednesday, tracking global equities, as oil prices fell on hopes the Strait of Hormuz could reopen after Iran resumed talks with neighbouring Oman on managing the strategic waterway.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian shares opened marginally higher on Wednesday, tracking global equities, as oil prices fell on hopes the Strait of Hormuz could reopen after Iran resumed talks with neighbouring Oman on managing the strategic waterway. The Nifty 50 (.NSEI) rose 0.03% to 24,341.95 and the BSE Sensex (.BSESN) shed 0.30% to 77,892.10, as of 9:15 a.m. IST. Thirteen of the 16 major sectors advanced at the open, although the gains were marginal. The broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100) added about 0.2% each. Other Asian markets rose as Brent crude fell 2.7% to $86.2 a barrel after Iran and Oman said they [USN:L8N44M1SQ TEXT:"discussed"] a joint temporary navigational corridor through the Strait and agreed to clear it of mines. Despite the ongoing tensions, the U.S. is beginning to send personnel back to some diplomatic missions in the Middle East that were evacuated or downsized amid the conflict with Iran, [USN:L6N44M0IT TEXT:"two people familiar with the matter told Reuters"].

item.title: サッカー＝マンＵ、カメルーン代表ＭＦバレバを約130億円で獲得
item.description: ［２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２５日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグ、マンチェスター・ユナイテッド（マンＵ）は２５日、同リーグのブライトンからカメルーン代表ＭＦカルロス・バレバ（２２）を獲得し、２０３１年まで契約を結んだと発表した。

契約には１年延長のオプションが付帯。移籍金の詳細は明かされていないが、チーム関係者の話では基本額６０００万ポンド（約１３０億円）で、条件に応じて今後追加の支払いが発生するという。

バレバは２３年にリール（フランス）からブライトンに加入し、３シーズンで公式戦１１２試合に出場した。一昨季にブレークした同選手を巡っては、マンＵが昨年に獲得を狙っているとのうわさもあったが、英メディアは、ブライトンが同選手を１億ポンドと評価したことで移籍話が見送りとなったと伝えている。

バレバは声明で「夢に見たクラブに加入できて、信じられない気持ちだ。オールド・トラフォード（マンＵのホームスタジアム）でのプレーはいつだって特別だが、マンチェスター・ユナイテッドの選手としてプレーできる機会を手にできて、心から光栄に思う」と話した。 　同選手はプレシーズン中に足首の靱帯を痛めたが、英メディアは長期離脱は回避できる見通しと報じている。

item.title: Asian stocks hesitant before Nvidia, oil slips on Hormuz hopes
item.description: Asian stocks stuttered on Wednesday as a drop in oil prices dragged bond yields lower on hopes that the critical Strait of Hormuz could reopen, while investors braced for yet another make-or-break earnings report from AI bellwether Nvidia.
item.dc:creator: Ankur Banerjee
item.content:encoded: Asian stocks stuttered on Wednesday as a drop in oil prices dragged bond yields lower on hopes that the critical Strait of Hormuz could reopen, while investors braced for yet another make-or-break earnings report from AI bellwether [USN:L6N44A0N8 TEXT:"Nvidia"]. Iran said it had restarted [USN:L8N44M1SQ TEXT:"talks with Oman"] to manage the Strait, as it faces heightened economic pressure from U.S. President Donald Trump in the nearly six-month conflict that has roiled oil markets and stoked global inflationary worries. Brent crude futures fell for a third straight day on Wednesday, sliding more than 2% to $86.41 per barrel on the prospect of more [USN:L6N44A0NK TEXT:"supply"] coming through the strait, which handled a fifth of the world's traded oil before the war. That helped push bond yields lower, with the yield on U.S. 10-year notes at 4.634% after falling 6.5 basis points on Tuesday. "While there was no real progress or details of the Iran-Oman deal, as Iran reiterated that Hormuz will remain shut until conditions are met, price action suggested that markets are quickly pricing in optimism around an interim announcement," analysts at J.P. Morgan said in a note. WAITING FOR NVIDIA Investors turned cautious ahead of Nvidia's (NVDA.O) second-quarter earnings later in the day, with their focus on whether the massive AI spending boom is sustainable and can turn profits that will satisfy markets. MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MISX00000PUS) was up 0.12% in early trading, set for a 2% rise in the month. Japan's Nikkei (.N225) eased 0.4% while the tech-heavy KOSPI (.KS11) dipped 0.2%. Nasdaq futures fell 0.5%, while European futures were flat in Asian hours. "Nvidia is approaching the point where beating expectations is expected, so the headline numbers alone may not determine the market reaction," said Charu Chanana, chief investment strategist at Saxo in Singapore. "The question is less whether Nvidia beats and more how big the beat is and whether guidance is strong enough to keep earnings expectations moving higher," Chanana said. She pointed out that [USN:L6N44I0TK TEXT:"options data"] hints at a smaller move after earnings compared to previous profit announcements, suggesting Nvidia’s results are becoming somewhat more predictable. Analysts expect Nvidia to forecast an 82.8% rise in third-quarter sales to $104.20 billion. Adjusted gross margin for the second and third quarters is expected to remain around 75%. J.P. Morgan analysts said it was likely that Nvidia's earnings release will be "supportive of the AI trade though perhaps without giving a material near-term boost" to the semiconductor sector. U.S. INFLATION DATA UP NEXT The currency markets remained calm with the dollar holding steady as traders awaited the latest U.S. inflation data later in the day, ahead of the Jackson Hole symposium this weekend. The dollar index , which measures the U.S. currency against six other units, was at 98.934 but set for a 1% decline for August. Investors have been grappling with the U.S. Treasury department's renewed efforts to ease pressure on longer-dated bond yields as it expanded its debt buyback program. "While this will ease overall interest costs at the margin, it does not change the underlying drivers of rising interest payments: the US government’s rising stock of debt and concerns about fiscal dominance/Fed independence," said Kristina Clifton, an economist at Commonwealth Bank of Australia. The move has resulted in the pressure shifting to the dollar from the bond market, reviving the [USN:L1N44H0RB TEXT:"debasement trade"], in which investors buy assets like gold and bitcoin, betting that government spending and debt will erode the value of currencies. Spot gold last fetched $4,646.08 per ounce, just shy of the three-month high it touched in the previous session. Bitcoin was 0.6% higher at $78,704.

item.title: 米南部州共和上院予備選、故グラム氏妹が勝利 トランプ氏に追い風
item.description:
Richard Cowan
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Richard Cowan

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - １１月の米連邦上院選に向け、南部サウスカロライナ州で２５日に行われた共和党予備選決選投票で、故リンゼー・グラム上院議員の妹ダーリン・グラム氏（６２）が勝利したと、米メディアが伝えた。支持を表明していたトランプ大統領にとって追い風となる。

ダーリン氏は兄のリンゼー氏が７月に死去したことを受け、残りの任期の来年１月初めまで議席を引き継ぐ暫定議員に任命されていた。今回の決選投票でラルフ・ノーマン下院議員を破り、１１月の本選で任期６年の上院議席を争う。

本選では民主党候補の小児科医アニー・アンドリュース氏と対決するが、保守色の強い同州では容易に勝利すると予想されている。

トランプ氏は自身のスーパーＰＡＣ（政治活動委員会）「ＭＡＧＡ　ＩＮＣ」から多額の選挙資金を拠出してダーリン氏を支援。２１日には応援演説に駆けつけ、「投票用紙に載っているのは私だ」などと述べていた。

今回の予備選は、今年の中間選挙でトランプ氏が有権者に対して持つ影響力を試す試金石の一つとみられていた。

今回の選挙サイクルでトランプ氏が支持を表明した候補の勝敗はまちまちで、世論調査では物価上昇やイランとの戦争が引き続き重しになっていることが示されている。

item.title: 米長期債に強気、弱気ポジション集中－シタデル・セキュリティーズ
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： シタデル・セキュリティーズのフランク・フライト氏は先月、米国債投資家にとって厳しい夏になると警告したばかりだが、今ではリスクのバランスが相場上昇に傾いているとみている。弱気のポジションに投資家が集中していることや、インフレ圧力の緩和を示す指標を理由に挙げた。

マクロ戦略責任者を務めるフライト氏は25日のリポートで、「現在、リスクの非対称性は長期ゾーンの利回り低下に傾いているとみている」とした。

インフレや財政赤字への懸念に加え、AIインフラ投資を賄うテクノロジー企業の相次ぐ債券発行を背景に、米長期国債はここ数週間、下押し圧力を受けてきた。30年債利回りは先週、約20年ぶりの高水準まで急上昇した。これを受け、ベッセント米財務長官は相場下落に歯止めをかけるため、残存期間10－30年の米国債の買い戻しを拡大する方針を表明した。

フライト氏によると、商品投資顧問業者（CTA）などが採用するトレンド追随型戦略についてシタデル・セキュリティーズが行ったシミュレーションでは、弱気ポジションは最近と比べても「かなり極端な水準にある」。このため、米国債がさらに値下がりしても売りが大きく膨らむ可能性は低い一方、相場の上昇が続けば、空売り勢が買い戻しを迫られる可能性があるという。

今回の強気見通しは、フライト氏にとって従来の見方からの転換となる。7月上旬には、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）のウォーシュ新議長がインフレ抑制に取り組む決意を債券投資家は過小評価していると警告していた。7月29日の米金融政策決定では、多くのエコノミストが金利据え置きを予想するなか、フライト氏は利上げを見込んでいた。

米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）は実際にはこの会合で金利を据え置いた。ただ、ウォーシュ氏の記者会見での発言を受け、インフレ抑制に向けた姿勢への疑念が広がり、長期債の売りを招いた。

フライト氏は現在、こうした信認への懸念は行き過ぎだと主張する。雇用の弱さやインフレ圧力の緩和を示す最近の経済指標は、「よりハト派的な政策対応が妥当だったことを裏付けたようだ」としている。

item.title: Trump administration pauses visa appointments for applicants worldwide
item.description: Immigrant visa applicants with scheduled interviews at US embassies and consulates have received emails that their appointments were being rescheduled and that they would receive future notice of a new date, the Financial Times reported.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Trump administration pauses visa appointments for applicants worldwide

Immigrant visa applicants with scheduled interviews at US embassies and consulates have received emails that their appointments were being rescheduled and that they would receive future notice of a new date, the Financial Times reported.

A woman waits to fill out a US visa application form at a consultancy that assists with visa paperwork in Kathmandu, Nepal, on Nov 28, 2025. (File photo: Reuters/Navesh Chitrakar)

WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump's administration has issued a pause on visa appointments for applicants around the world during an ongoing immigration crackdown by the US government in the Republican leader's second term in the White House. A US State Department spokesperson said on Tuesday (Aug 25) that it launched a global training initiative at all US embassies and consulates worldwide and that appointments for visa services will be adjusted to accommodate the training. Trump has pursued an aggressive deportation drive and immigration crackdown that includes revocations of visas and green cards and rejection of applications over a range of reasons like political opinions and pro-Palestinian protests against US ally Israel's assault on Gaza. He says the crackdown aims to improve domestic security.

The crackdown has faced some legal setbacks. A US judge on Friday struck down a Trump administration policy suspending the issuance of immigrant visas to applicants from 75 countries, saying that the policy exceeded Secretary of State Marco Rubio's statutory authority. The State Department did not specify details on the training and its timeline, beyond saying the training aimed to help consular officers screen out applicants deemed likely to become dependent on US public benefits and to ensure evaluation of visa applicants "comprehensively and consistently". The pause on visa appointments was reported earlier by the Financial Times, which said immigrant visa applicants with scheduled interviews at US embassies and consulates have received emails that their appointments were being rescheduled and that they would receive future notice of a new date. Trump's immigration crackdown has been widely condemned by human rights groups as being discriminatory and in violation of free speech and due process rights. Rights groups also say the crackdown has created an unsafe environment in the US, especially for ethnic minorities who have raised concerns about racial profiling. While Trump campaigned in 2024 on a platform of stopping illegal immigration, his administration has also made legal immigration more difficult - for example, by imposing new and expensive fees for applicants of certain work visas.

item.title: Sky ban Enes Kanter Freedom from arena after altercation
item.description: Two days after ejecting Enes Kanter Freedom from Wintrust Arena during a game, the Chicago Sky announced Tuesday that they have banned the former NBA player from the building.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Two days after ejecting Enes Kanter Freedom from Wintrust Arena during a game, the Chicago Sky announced Tuesday that they have banned the former NBA player from the building. Kanter Freedom, sitting courtside during the Sky's 113-90 loss to the Indiana Fever on Sunday, stood up and took a step onto the court with his arms outstretched after Sky guard Natasha Cloud began pointing and yelling at him at the start of an Indiana timeout. A game official and security personnel got between them, and her teammates pulled Cloud away. The official gestured for Kanter Freedom to be ejected, and he was escorted from his seat by team and arena security. Kanter Freedom, 34, wore a black T-shirt that read: "WOMAN noun. Adult human female." Sky owner Michael Alter spoke with media Tuesday and said Kanter Freedom started to "chirp" and "engage" Cloud and that he believed Kanter Freedom was hoping to provoke Cloud, who is a supporter of the LGBTQ+ community. "He has demonstrated to us unequivocally that he has the potential to be a threat," Alter said, according to reports. "That he is not able to control himself to the extent where we can be comfortable that he may (not) step towards the court again and towards the players. "So that is the basis for which we will not permit him into the building until such time as he can prove otherwise." Cloud, 34, posted a statement on social media after the game. "To every trans kid/person, You are apart of MY community & tribe. You belong. You're loved. You're seen. You're perfect as you are. & you will always be protected by me," Cloud wrote. Kanter Freedom, who had a conversation with police officers before exiting Wintrust Arena, later wrote on his X account, "I just got kicked out of a @WNBA game for supporting WOMEN! Let that sink in, America." Kanter Freedom, formerly known as Enes Kanter, played center for 11 years in the NBA for five teams from 2011-12 to 2021-22 and averaged 11.2 points, 7.8 rebounds and 21.5 minutes in 748 regular-season games (259 starts). He also has spoken out on social issues, including the debate about transgender athletes. The WNBA, which has never had a known transgender player, has been ensnared in the issue, only heightened when the Fever's Sophie Cunningham came out strongly in favor of women's sports being solely for women. Kanter Freedom and another former NBA player, Royce White, declared their intention to enter the 2027 WNBA Draft, and both claimed to now identify as women. But multiple reports Monday said that the league considers them ineligible for the draft, though Kanter Freedom told the New York Post that he has not been notified of any such decision. --Field Level Media

item.title: Martin Damm slams top-seeded Daniil Medvedev at Winston-Salem
item.description: Wild-card entrant Martin Damm needed just 1 hour, 22 minutes to knock out No. 1 seed Daniil Medvedev of Russia 7-5, 6-3 in second-round action on Tuesday at the Winston-Salem Open in North Carolina.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Wild-card entrant Martin Damm needed just 1 hour, 22 minutes to knock out No. 1 seed Daniil Medvedev of Russia 7-5, 6-3 in second-round action on Tuesday at the Winston-Salem Open in North Carolina. The 6-foot-8 Damm used his length at the net to pull off the upset. While Medvedev won just 2 of 4 points when he was at the net, Damm won 20 of his 28 advances. Damm also never dropped his serve, saving both break points he faced. No. 2 seed Luciano Darderi of Italy and No. 3 seed Ignacio Buse of Peru were pushed to three sets before winning their second-round matches while No. 4 seed Arthur Fery of Great Britain needed just two sets. Belgium's Raphael Collignon, the No. 5 seed, and Argentina's Mariano Navone, the No. 6 seed, did not survive the second round. Australia's Rinky Hijikata rallied to handle Collignon 3-6, 7-6 (7), 7-6 (5) while Australia's James Duckworth dropped Navone 6-3, 7-6 (5). Frenchmen Luca Van Assche and Quentin Halys, the 11th and 12th seeds, respectively, were upset in the second round, as was No. 14 seed Tomas Machac of the Czech Republic. Eighth-seeded Juan Manuel Cerundolo of Argentina and 13th-seeded Botic van de Zandschulp of the Netherlands both earned straight-set wins. No. 9 seed Adrian Mannarino of France was among the three seeded players engaged in second-round action on Tuesday night. --Field Level Media

item.title: Back from IL, Hunter Goodman goes deep as Rockies top Nats, end skid
item.description: Hunter Goodman homered in his return from the injured list as the Colorado Rockies snapped a seven-game losing streak with a 3-1 win over the host Washington Nationals on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Hunter Goodman homered in his return from the injured list as the Colorado Rockies snapped a seven-game losing streak with a 3-1 win over the host Washington Nationals on Tuesday. Jordan Beck collected two hits for Colorado, which leveled the four-game series at one victory apiece. The Rockies, who entered the game with the fourth-highest bullpen ERA in the majors (4.88), got five innings of scoreless relief. Mark Manfredi (1-0) pitched one inning for his first big-league win, and Jordan Romano worked the ninth for his 13th save. Daylen Lile had two hits, including a homer in his second straight game, but the Nationals lost for the ninth time in 11 games. Washington went 0-for-6 with runners in scoring position and totaled five hits one night after scoring 13 runs on 13 hits. Mason Adams started for Colorado and pitched four innings in his major league debut. He allowed a run on three hits and three walks while striking out five. Washington starter Andrew Alvarez (2-6) gave up three runs on five hits over 4 2/3 innings. He struck out six and walked two. Goodman, who missed the past two weeks due to a left shoulder strain, led off the fourth inning with his 35th homer of the season to open the scoring. After TJ Rumfield walked, Willi Castro grounded into a fielder's choice. Connor Norby then doubled to center, driving in Castro. Lile hit his 17th homer of the season leading off the bottom of the fourth to pull the Nationals within 2-1. Beck singled leading off the Colorado fifth and went to second on a one-out single by Jake McCarthy. On a wild pitch, Beck tried to score from second and was initially called out at home. However, Nationals third baseman Brady House was called for obstructing Beck, and the Rockies led 3-1. Rumfield walked and Castro doubled with two outs in the eighth inning, but Max Kranick struck out Norby to end the threat. Romano worked around a two-out walk in the ninth, inducing a game-ending flyout from pinch hitter Keibert Ruiz. --Field Level Media

item.title: Corte Constitucional de Colombia aprueba mayor parte de la reforma pensional, devuelve algunos artículos al Congreso
item.description: La Corte Constitucional de Colombia aprobó el martes la mayor parte de una reforma al sistema pensional de 2024, aunque ordenó a la Cámara de Representantes corregir el trámite de un grupo específico de artículos por vicios de procedimiento.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Corte Constitucional de Colombia aprobó el martes la mayor parte de una reforma al sistema pensional de 2024, aunque ordenó a la Cámara de Representantes corregir el trámite de un grupo específico de artículos por vicios de procedimiento. La decisión, adoptada por una votación de 7 a 1 en la Sala Plena del tribunal, respondió a un análisis sobre si la plenaria de la Cámara había subsanado un vicio procedimental identificado previamente por la propia Corte en 2025. No obstante, la Corte devolvió a la Cámara de Representantes disposiciones puntuales, incluidos apartes de nueve artículos, así como una propuesta para un artículo nuevo, por considerar que no fueron tramitadas de manera correcta. La plenaria de la Cámara tendrá un plazo de 30 días hábiles, contados desde la notificación del fallo, para tramitar las proposiciones legislativas pendientes vinculadas a esos artículos. Si resulta necesario un proceso de conciliación entre las dos cámaras del Congreso, este deberá surtirse durante la legislatura en curso. La Corte precisó que la validez constitucional y entrada en vigor de las disposiciones devueltas quedarán condicionadas al resultado del proceso de corrección. En un punto adicional, el tribunal determinó que las normas ya declaradas constitucionales de la reforma pensional entrarán en vigencia a partir del 1 de abril de 2027. El fallo se produjo después de que la Cámara de Representantes aprobó por segunda vez, en junio de 2025, la reforma pensional que el tribunal le había devuelto para subsanar un vicio de procedimiento. La aprobación inicial fue demandada con el argumento de que la Cámara autorizó el texto avalado por el Senado sin un debate de fondo. REFORMA PARA FORTALECER A COLPENSIONES La reforma busca fortalecer la administradora estatal Colpensiones, reducir los subsidios a las altas jubilaciones, entregar beneficios a las mujeres con hijos y ampliar la cobertura para proteger a los adultos mayores en situación de pobreza. La iniciativa mantiene en 62 años la edad de pensión para los hombres con 1.300 semanas de cotización y en 57 años para las mujeres, aunque reduce el requisito a 850 semanas en casos especiales según el número de hijos. La norma obliga a todos los colombianos que ganan hasta 2,3 salarios mínimos mensuales, unos cuatro millones de pesos (1.317 dólares), a realizar sus aportes de pensión a la estatal Colpensiones. Las personas con salarios por encima de esa suma podrán seleccionar un fondo de pensiones privado para el ahorro individual de los excedentes. Además, establece que los trabajadores que no lograron cotizar suficientes semanas para una pensión accederán a un beneficio económico, mientras que las personas en situación de pobreza o vulnerabilidad que no aportaron al sistema recibirán mensualmente una renta de unos 75 dólares. El Gobierno del expresidente izquierdista Gustavo Petro, que impulsó la reforma, estimó que más de 2,6 millones de adultos mayores se beneficiarán de las medidas solidarias. Los hombres con 900 semanas cotizadas y las mujeres con 750 continuarán en el sistema actual y no estarán obligados a aportar al fondo estatal. El Gobierno del presidente Abelardo De La Espriella, quien asumió el 7 de agosto, busca consolidar una mayoría en el legislativo donde el partido izquierdista Pacto Histórico tiene la mayor cantidad de congresistas. Aún no está claro cómo votará la derecha, actualmente fragmentada, sobre esta legislación insignia del expresidente Petro. La reforma es uno de los cambios de política social más significativos de Colombia en años, según analistas, quienes destacan que ampliará el papel del Estado en el sistema de pensiones, mientras que preserva un rol para los fondos privados, un tema que por mucho tiempo ha dividido a legisladores, empresas y sindicatos.

item.title: Dollar moves in a narrow range ahead of inflation data, Jackson Hole
item.description: The dollar was rangebound in early Asian trading on Wednesday as an uneasy calm hung over currency markets, with investors awaiting inflation reports from major economies including the U.S. ahead of the Jackson Hole symposium this weekend.
item.dc:creator: Gregor Hunter
item.content:encoded: The dollar was rangebound in early Asian trading on Wednesday as an uneasy calm hung over currency markets, with investors awaiting inflation reports from major economies including the U.S. ahead of the Jackson Hole symposium this weekend. The greenback remained pinned in the narrow trading range it has sat in for the past week against most of its major peers ahead of the release of PCE data for July later on Wednesday. "Signs of Middle East de-escalation, including plans to return U.S. diplomatic staff to the region and efforts to reopen the Strait between Iran and Oman, weighed on oil prices and supported broader risk sentiment," Westpac analysts wrote in a note. The U.S. dollar index , which measures the greenback's strength against a basket of six currencies, snapped a three-day winning streak on Tuesday, and was holding steady at 98.918 in early Asian trading. Oil prices slid in the Asian day on Wednesday, with Brent crude down 2.1% at $86.68, as Iran said it had [USN:L8N44M1SQ TEXT:"restarted talks"] with neighbour Oman to manage the Strait of Hormuz and diplomatic negotiations between Washington and Tehran remained stalled. The Australian dollar was up 0.1% at $0.7172 after the release of data showing the trimmed [USN:AZN4TGC1E TEXT:"mean CPI inflation measure"] rose at an annualised rate of 3.6%. Its kiwi counterpart was down 0.2% at $0.5962 ahead of an interest rate decision from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand next Wednesday. The market overwhelmingly expects the central bank to hike interest rates by 25 basis points to 2.75%, according to LSEG data. However, the U.S. dollar weakened 0.1% against the Canadian dollar to C$1.38405 per dollar, retracing some of its gains against the loonie over the past two days after Ottawa hit back on Tuesday with [USN:L6N44M0TW TEXT:"retaliatory tariffs"] on about $20 billion worth of U.S. annual imports and rolled out aid for businesses and workers, after trade talks with Washington collapsed last week. YEN STEADY The euro was flat at $1.1675, while the British pound was also unchanged at $1.3647. The yen was steady at 159.14 yen, remaining firmly below levels that triggered joint intervention by U.S. and Japanese officials in the past month. Influential currency investor Stephen Jen said that the move marked a "[USN:L1N44L0KA TEXT:"watershed moment"]" for the currency. The central bank said on Wednesday that Governor Kazuo Ueda [USN:P8N44I00B TEXT:"will not attend"] the U.S. Federal Reserve's annual Jackson Hole gathering this week due to a schedule conflict. Bank of Japan board member Naoki Tamura will attend on his behalf. A majority of economists in a [USN:L4N44I0F4 TEXT:"Reuters poll"] said the Bank of Japan will likely move more swiftly than previously expected and raise interest rates again in September, with the terminal rate also likely to be higher. Cryptocurrencies continued to roar back to life as investors revived dollar debasement trades. Bitcoin was up 0.8% at $78,829.03, while ether was up 0.7% at $2,453.10. So far this month, they are up 25% and 31%, respectively. However, gold slipped 0.5% to $4,633.94, paring its monthly gains to 15%.

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝ブレーザーズ、シャープが半月板を損傷─報道
item.description: ［２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２５日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のトレイルブレーザーズでプレーするシェイドン・シャープ（２３）が右膝半月板を損傷し、約６カ月離脱する見通しであることが分かった。米ＥＳＰＮが２４日に報じた。

シャープは２０２５─２６年シーズンに左腓骨の問題で３２試合を欠場するなか、自己最多となる１試合平均２０．８得点を記録。４．３リバウンド、２．６アシストもマークし、ブレーザーズの２１年以来となるポストシーズン進出に貢献した。

２２年ドラフト全体７位で指名されたシャープは、ＮＢＡ通算２３４試合（先発１３４試合）に出場し、１試合平均１５．７得点、４．０リバウンド、２．２アシストを記録。昨年には４年総額９０００万ドル（約１４３億円）の契約延長に合意した。

item.title: Australia inflation runs hot in July, adding to rate hike risk
item.description: Australian consumer prices rose more than expected in July as fuel and travel costs jumped, data showed on Wednesday, while core inflation also exceeded forecasts and added to the risk of another hike in interest rates.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australian consumer prices rose more than expected in July as fuel and travel costs jumped, data showed on Wednesday, while core inflation also exceeded forecasts and added to the risk of another hike in interest rates. The Australian dollar rose 0.2% to $0.7176, while three-year government bond futures reversed an earlier rally to be last down 3 ticks at 95.42. Market participants nudged up the chance of a fourth rate hike from the Reserve Bank of Australia next month to 36% from 17%, while a move by February next year is now priced at 94%. After the hot figures, Deutsche Bank is now calling for a quarter-point rate hike from the RBA in September, citing fresh upside risks to inflation. "We think the July CPI leaves little room for the RBA to do anything other than follow-through on its hawkish posturing, and the earlier it does, the better," said Phil Odonaghoe, an economist at Deutsche Bank. Data from the Australian Bureau of Statistics showed its monthly consumer price index (CPI) rose 1.0% in July from June, exceeding forecasts of a 0.8% rise, as fuel prices jumped 7.5% after falling for three months. The annual pace slowed to 3.5% from 3.8%, countering expectations for a sharp slowdown to 3.3% due to an outsized increase from last year dropping out of the calculation. The trimmed mean measure of core inflation increased 0.5% in the month, the biggest increase in a year and well above forecasts for 0.3%, leaving the annual pace at 3.6%. The RBA held interest rates steady at 4.35% this month for a second consecutive meeting after three rate hikes this year aimed at taming inflation. Policymakers have warned that they would hike again if inflation risks build . Minutes from the [USN:P8N43N01C TEXT:"central bank"] released on Tuesday showed several board members judged it was quite possible the upside inflation risks would materialise, requiring some further tightening. The bank had forecast trimmed mean inflation to slow to 3.3% by the end of the year. Wednesday's report showed new dwelling prices jumped 5.7% in July from a year ago, slowing a touch from a 5.8% rise the previous month, as builders passed on higher material and labour costs, the ABS said. Rent inflation held steady at an elevated rate of 3.6%. Prices for tradeable goods jumped 1.5% thanks to the jump in fuel costs, compared with a drop of 0.8% the previous month. "There is a real risk that inflation remains too high and fails to fall in line with the RBA's – in our view – optimistic forecasts," said Harry Murphy Cruise, head of economic research for Oxford Economics Australia.

item.title: Meta, US states have discussed settling teen social media harm case, Bloomberg News reports
item.description: Meta Platforms and state attorneys general have discussed a potential mid-trial settlement of a lawsuit accusing the company of deliberately designing Facebook and Instagram to be addictive to young users, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Meta Platforms (META.O) and state attorneys general have discussed a potential mid-trial settlement of a lawsuit accusing the company of deliberately designing Facebook and Instagram to be addictive to young users, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter. The report comes during a federal court trial in California over claims brought by 29 states, in what is one of the highest-profile tests of allegations that social media companies have harmed young users. Just days before jury selection began on August 12, a federal appeals court [USN:L6N3YF1AZ TEXT:"declined"] to halt the trial. Meta and the attorneys general of California, Colorado, Kentucky and New Jersey did not immediately respond to requests for comment outside of regular business hours. Late Tuesday, several state attorneys general put out advisories notifying the media of plans for press conferences, including Nevada Attorney General Aaron Ford, whose office said it planned to announce "a major consumer protection settlement involving a leading technology company." The claims are part of a broader wave of litigation brought by states, local governments, school districts and individuals alleging that Meta and other social media companies fueled a nationwide youth mental health crisis. The federal court trial covered claims from the attorneys general of Colorado, California, Kentucky and New Jersey that Meta violated their state laws protecting consumers. The trial also covered claims from 29 states that Meta violated the federal Children's Online Privacy Protection Act by collecting personal data from users it knew were children without parental notification or consent and using the data to train machine learning and generative AI models. Meta has denied the allegations, saying it has worked hard to protect children on its platforms. The company had argued it could not have misled consumers about whether its services were addictive because "social media addiction" is not a recognized psychiatric condition.

item.title: バングラデシュ、「メッカ共同防衛協定」参加検討に前向き＝高官
item.description:
Ruma Paul
[ダッカ ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ruma Paul

[ダッカ ２５日 ロイター] - バングラデシュのカビール国務大臣（外務担当）は２４日、記者団に対して、サウジアラビア、トルコ、パキスタンの３カ国が今月署名した「メッカ共同防衛協定」への参加をバングラデシュ政府が検討する可能性があると述べた。バングラデシュが同協定への参加に動けば、隣国インドなどとの外交関係が複雑化しそうだ。

バングラデシュは、インドの国境警備隊が人々を強制的にバングラデシュ側へ送り込んでいると非難している。また、２０２４年８月の抗議運動で失脚して以降、インドに亡命しているハシナ前首相の身柄引き渡しをインド側に求めている。

カビール氏は「中東のイスラム諸国の間で安全保障上の枠組みがあるのであれば、われわれが参加を検討することは不自然ではない。前向きに受け止めている」と述べた。サウジなど３カ国からバングラデシュの指導部、特にラーマン首相に対して参加を呼びかける動きがあったという。

バングラデシュ外務省の関係者もロイターに対し、サウジからバングラデシュ政府に対して協定への参加要請があったと明らかにした。招請がいつ行われたかについては言及しなかった。情報提供の権限がないとして匿名を条件に取材に応じた。

イスラム教スンニ派が多数を占めるサウジなど３カ国は今月、サウジの聖地メッカで、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）の集団防衛原則をモデルとした同協定に署名した。協定には、いずれかの国に対する攻撃は全てに対する攻撃と見なすとの規定が盛り込まれている。

バングラデシュはトルコと同様に世俗主義共和国だが、人口の９０％以上がイスラム教スンニ派を自認している。

バングラデシュ駐在のサウジ、トルコ、パキスタンの各大使館は、コメント要請に対して直ちには回答しなかった。

バングラデシュは、投資の呼び込みや輸出拡大、競合する大国との経済関係維持を図るため、対立する地政学的陣営のいずれにも与しない姿勢を取ってきた。

地政学アナリストのコロル・キブリア氏は、バングラデシュが同協定に正式に加われば、インドだけでなく、中国、イラン、日本、クウェート、オマーン、カタール、ロシア、アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）、米国との関係も複雑になる可能性があると指摘。「こうした国々との関係が自動的に断絶するわけではない。しかし、バングラデシュが特定の軍事ブロックに加われば、同国がどちらの陣営に属するのかという問題を避けることは、はるかに難しくなる」と述べた。

item.title: Max Clark's blast lifts Tigers past Rays, snaps skid
item.description: Max Clark hit his second career home run to help propel host Detroit to a 4-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays on Tuesday, ending the Tigers' six-game losing streak.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Max Clark hit his second career home run to help propel host Detroit to a 4-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays on Tuesday, ending the Tigers' six-game losing streak. Javier Baez scored two runs and Hao-Yu Lee added an RBI single for Detroit. Detroit starter Jackson Jobe gave up one run on four hits and three walks with four strikeouts in 4 1/3 innings. Drew Sommers (1-3) didn't allow a baserunner in 1 2/3 innings while picking up his first major league win. Kenley Jansen got the last three outs to record his 17th save. Tampa Bay starter Casey Legumina served in an expanded opener role, going 2 1/3 innings before giving way to Ian Seymour, who finished the game. Seymour (9-5) gave up all four runs -- three earned -- and seven hits in 5 2/3 innings. Seymour added five strikeouts without a walk in the middle game of the three-game series. Junior Caminero had two hits and scored the lone run for the American League East Division leaders. Jonny DeLuca had the lone RBI. The Rays took the lead in the fourth but it could have been more. Caminero led off with a single and moved to third on Liam Hicks' double. One out later, Caminero scored on DeLuca's infield single. Cedric Mullins walked to load the bases but Jobe escaped further damage by retiring the next two batters on a strikeout and groundout. Detroit left two runners on in the bottom of the inning but broke through with three runs in the fifth. Spencer Torkelson led off with a single. After a fielder's choice, Clark whacked a sweeper from Seymour over the right field wall to make it 2-1. Gleyber Torres reached on a bloop single that dropped between second baseman Richie Palacios and DeLuca in right. Torres advanced to second on a balk and scored when first baseman Jonathan Aranda misplayed Kevin McGonigle's grounder. The Tigers extended their lead to 4-1 in the seventh. Baez led off with a triple. The next two batters failed to bring him in but Lee smacked a single to left to score him. --Field Level Media

item.title: ゴルフ＝ＰＧＡツアーがプレーオフ改革、28年からマッチプレー方式へ
item.description:
［２５日 ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフのＰＧＡツアーは２５日、２０２８年からシーズン終盤の競技方式を大幅に変更し、ツアー王者をマッチプレー方式で決定すると発表した。
新たなプレーオフは３週間で実施。まず年間ポイントランキング上位９０人が７２ホールのストロークプレーによる「ＰＧＡツアー・チャンピオンシップシリーズ・フィナーレ」に出場し、年間ポイント王者を決めるとともに、ツアー選手権に進む３２人を決定する。
ツアー選手権では、異なる会場で２週間にわたってマッチプレーを実施。第１週は３２人を８組に分け、各選手が同組の他の３人と対戦し、各組上位２人の計１６人が第２週へ進む。
第２週は優勝争いを１６人による勝ち抜き方式で行い、４ラウンドを実施。無敗で勝ち上がった２人が最終ラウンドでツアー王者の座を争う。
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２５日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフのＰＧＡツアーは２５日、２０２８年からシーズン終盤の競技方式を大幅に変更し、ツアー王者をマッチプレー方式で決定すると発表した。

新たなプレーオフは３週間で実施。まず年間ポイントランキング上位９０人が７２ホールのストロークプレーによる「ＰＧＡツアー・チャンピオンシップシリーズ・フィナーレ」に出場し、年間ポイント王者を決めるとともに、ツアー選手権に進む３２人を決定する。

ツアー選手権では、異なる会場で２週間にわたってマッチプレーを実施。第１週は３２人を８組に分け、各選手が同組の他の３人と対戦し、各組上位２人の計１６人が第２週へ進む。

第２週は優勝争いを１６人による勝ち抜き方式で行い、４ラウンドを実施。無敗で勝ち上がった２人が最終ラウンドでツアー王者の座を争う。

現在のプレーオフはストロークプレー３大会で構成され、出場人数を７０人、５０人、３０人と段階的に絞り込む方式。タイガー・ウッズが委員長を務める９人構成の委員会は、ファンにとって分かりやすく、各試合の重要性やシーズンを通じた物語性を高めることを改革の目的と説明している。

今回の変更は、ＰＧＡツアーが６月に承認した２８年からの新競技制度を具体化したもの。同制度では「チャンピオンシップシリーズ」を上位、「チャレンジャーシリーズ」を下位とする２階層制を設け、昇格・降格制度を導入する。

item.title: Father of sailor aboard US aircraft carrier freed from immigration detention
item.description: A Nicaraguan immigrant taken into custody by U.S. Border Patrol agents while his son, a U.S. Navy sailor, was deployed at sea aboard an aircraft carrier during the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, was freed from detention, his family said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh, Steve Gorman
item.content:encoded: A Nicaraguan immigrant taken into custody by U.S. Border Patrol agents while his son, a U.S. Navy sailor, was deployed at sea aboard an aircraft carrier during the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, was freed from detention, his family said on Tuesday. The family's announcement on Facebook that Luis Manuel Aviles Roa had been released came three days after Joshua Aviles went public about his father's arrest, lamenting the heartbreak he felt serving his country while his father was locked away. In his Facebook post on Saturday, Joshua Aviles said his father was picked up by immigration authorities despite having a driver's license, Social Security card and work permit, and had been waiting to obtain a "green card" granting him permanent legal U.S. residency. "I've been deployed for over nine months, out at sea in the Middle East aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, fighting for a country that has given me everything," the sailor wrote. "I don't know how I can mentally continue working 12+ hour days knowing that my dad is somewhere, possibly being treated like a criminal." Border Patrol agents arrested the sailor's father after conducting a vehicle stop in Key West, Florida, according to the U.S. Department of Homeland Security. The DHS, parent agency of the Border Patrol, said Luis Manuel Aviles Roa had entered the U.S. illegally and would remain in Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention pending removal proceedings. "Having a family member in the military is not a free pass to violate our nation's laws," the DHS said in its statement on Sunday. But an update posted on Tuesday to the son's Facebook account said: "Luis has been released back to his family," adding, "We are grateful for all of the support for both Luis and Josh throughout this situation." No explanation was offered for the change in the father's status. Neither the DHS nor ICE immediately responded to a Reuters request for comment. The Abraham Lincoln, which left the Middle East on Saturday, made recent headlines in separate news reports about challenges the crew faced during the ship's lengthy deployment for the Iran war, having not made a port of call in more than 200 days. Democratic lawmakers have said the aircraft carrier set a modern-day record for consecutive days at sea, an issue that gained national attention after sailors' families raised concerns about worsening conditions on the warship.

item.title: 中国実効支配の西沙諸島の小島に新たな建造物、レーダー施設か
item.description: 南シナ海で中国が実効支配する西沙（パラセル）諸島の鴨公島（ヤゴン島）で新たな施設が確認された。ロイターは先週、アンテロープ礁で中国が進めていた第1期工事が完了したもようだと伝えた。 ヤゴン島は、アンテロープ礁の北東14キロに位置する。両方とも西沙諸島西部の永楽（クレセント）群島内にある。 商業衛星画像提供会社バントールの17日撮影の衛星画像には、ヤゴン島に三つまたの建造物が見える。バントールは、建造物について、他の画像から建設が3月あたりに始まったと指摘。建物の目的は定かではないとした上で「南シナ海の他の場所で見られる軍事レーダーや早期警戒施設に似ており、近隣のアンテロープ礁の最終的な軍事的機能と関連している可能性が高い」と述べた。 西沙諸島の活動を監視しているオープンソース・インテリジェンスのトラッカー、ダミアン・サイモン氏は、レーダー施設である可能性はあるが、確固たる判断を下すには時期尚早だと述べた。 シンガポールを拠点とす
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: 南シナ海で中国が実効支配する西沙（パラセル）諸島の鴨公島（ヤゴン島）で新たな施設が確認された。ロイターは先週、アンテロープ礁で中国が進めていた第1期工事が完了したもようだと伝えた。 ヤゴン島は、アンテロープ礁の北東14キロに位置する。両方とも西沙諸島西部の永楽（クレセント）群島内にある。 商業衛星画像提供会社バントールの17日撮影の衛星画像には、ヤゴン島に三つまたの建造物が見える。バントールは、建造物について、他の画像から建設が3月あたりに始まったと指摘。建物の目的は定かではないとした上で「南シナ海の他の場所で見られる軍事レーダーや早期警戒施設に似ており、近隣のアンテロープ礁の最終的な軍事的機能と関連している可能性が高い」と述べた。 西沙諸島の活動を監視しているオープンソース・インテリジェンスのトラッカー、ダミアン・サイモン氏は、レーダー施設である可能性はあるが、確固たる判断を下すには時期尚早だと述べた。 シンガポールを拠点とする安全保障学者コリン・コー氏は、規模が限られていることから何らかの独立した観測所の可能性があるが、「知識に基づく推測をするとすれば、おそらくレーダー基地だろう」と語った。 アンテロープ礁の画像には、全長約6キロの人工島が写っている。3キロ以上の直線の海岸線があり、一部アナリストが滑走路になる可能性があると指摘する、 中国は新たな軍事基地の建設を認めていない。国営メディアはアンテロープ礁について天気予報、漁業保護、科学研究などの民間ニーズを満たすと伝えている。

item.title: トランプ氏支持のグラム氏が決選投票勝利へ、Sカロライナ上院予備選
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米サウスカロライナ州の連邦上院選共和党候補を決める特別予備選の決選投票で、ダーリン・グラム米上院議員が勝利する見通しとなった。同氏の兄リンゼー・グラム上院議員の死去に伴う予備選で、トランプ米大統領からの強力な支援が勝利を後押しした。
選挙データ分析サイトのディシジョン・デスクHQ（DDHQ）の集計によると、開票率約71%の時点で、グラム氏は53%を獲得。ラルフ・ノーマン下院議員は47%となっている。
保守強硬派で5期目のノーマン氏に対するグラム氏の勝利は、サウスカロライナ州の共和党予備選の有権者に対するトランプ氏の強い影響力と、同氏がグラム氏の勝利をいかに重視していたかを浮き彫りにした。
原題：Trump-Backed Graham Wins South Carolina Runoff, DDHQ

item.title: 米政権、世界各地でビザ面接を一時停止 移民取り締まり強化で
item.description:
Kanishka Singh
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kanishka Singh

[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権は移民取り締まりを強化する中、世界各地のビザ（査証）申請者を対象に面接予約を一時停止する措置を発表した。

国務省報道官は２５日、世界各地の全ての米大使館・領事館で職員研修の取り組みを始めたとし、研修に対応するためビザ関連業務の予約を調整すると述べた。

研修の詳細や実施期間については具体的に明らかにしていないが、米国の公的給付に依存する可能性が高いと見なされる申請者を領事官が選別できるよう支援し、ビザ申請者を「包括的かつ一貫性を持って」評価できるようにするのが目的だと説明した。

ビザ面接予約の一時停止について先に報じた英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）によると、米大使館や領事館で面接予約が入っていた移民ビザ申請者は、予約が変更され、新たな日程は改めて通知するとのメールを受け取ったという。

item.title: Ｆ１＝角田、オランダＧＰのパワーランキング6位 公式サイト
item.description: ［２５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２５日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の公式サイトは２５日、オランダ・グランプリ（ＧＰ）のパワーランキングを発表。レーシングブルズでレース復帰を果たした角田裕毅が６位タイにランクインした。

角田は昨季限りでレギュラーシートを失い、今季はリザーブドライバーを務めていたが、姉妹チームであるレッドブルのレギュラードライバー、アイザック・ハジャー（フランス）が練習中に手首を負傷したことでレーシングブルズからリアム・ローソン（ニュージーランド）が昇格。これに伴い、レーシングブルズの空枠に入った。

オランダＧＰで今季Ｆ１初出場となった角田は、２３日の決勝で１１位。ポイント圏内は逃したが、５人の専門家から成る審査員団の採点では、７位フィニッシュのローソンと同じレーススコア７．８点を獲得。「半年間レースから遠ざかり、次世代マシンにも慣れる必要があったことを考慮すれば、角田は見事に適応した。スーパーサブとして、ポイント獲得まであと一歩というところまで迫った」と高評価された。

Ｆ１公式サイトのパワーランキングは、各ＧＰ終了後に審査員団がドライバーを評価し、マシンの性能は考慮せずに１０点満点で採点。その採点を平均して、各ドライバーのレーススコアを算出する。

item.title: 日銀、植田総裁がジャクソンホール会議欠席－田村審議委員が出席予定
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 日本銀行は26日、植田和男総裁が今週予定されているジャクソンホール会合（カンザスシティー連銀主催の年次シンポジウム）を欠席すると発表した。田村直樹審議委員が代理出席する。日銀広報課が明らかにした。

植田総裁は31日から9月1日に米国のアシュビルで開かれる20カ国・地域（G20）財務相・中央銀行総裁会議には出席する見通し。6月には肝嚢胞感染症の治療のため、金融政策決定会合を欠席したが、7月会合には出席し、記者会見も行った。

item.title: Brazil Fines Tiktok Owner Bytedance for Unlawful Processing of Teenagers’ Data
item.description: By Rodrigo Viga Gaier, Ricardo Brito and Isabel Teles Brazil’s data protection authority, ANPD, has fined TikTok owner ByteDance $29.81 million for allegedly violating the country’s General Data Protection Law, according to a decision published in the official gazette on Tuesday. ANPD said that the …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
By Rodrigo Viga Gaier, Ricardo Brito and Isabel Teles

Brazil’s data protection authority, ANPD, has fined TikTok owner ByteDance $29.81 million for allegedly violating the country’s General Data Protection Law, according to a decision published in the official gazette on Tuesday.

ANPD said that the local unit of China’s ByteDance had processed personal data of teenagers aged 13 to 18 without a valid legal basis.

The regulator estimated that, during the period under review, TikTok may have processed the data of at least 8 million children, reflecting what it described as shortcomings in the platform’s age-verification system.

Brazilian authorities are stepping up scrutiny of online platforms’ safeguards for children and teenagers, part of a  broader global trend  that has seen countries, including Australia,  France  and China, impose or consider stricter rules on use of social media by minors.

This month, ANPD ordered chat platform Discord to suspend  livestreaming  features over concerns about children’s and teenagers’ exposure to harmful content.

ANPD Director Lorena Giuberti Coutinho said at a press conference on Tuesday that the agency was separately overseeing TikTok’s compliance with Brazil’s Digital Child and Adolescent Statute, a law that took effect in March.

More companies may face scrutiny by the agency soon.

On Friday, the regulator opened two new monitoring proceedings covering 22 digital platforms and social media networks to assess compliance with the new law to protect children.

Weak Safeguards

ANPD highlighted concerns about TikTok’s “logged-out feed,” which allows users to browse content without creating an account, enabling widespread use of the platform by children and teenagers in Brazil without effective age-verification checks.

The feature, the regulator said, is available in Brazil but not in the U.S. or Europe, where access is restricted to registered users.

The regulator added that TikTok also lacked adequate safeguards to mitigate the risks associated with the large-scale processing of children’s and teenagers’ data.

TikTok said in a statement the fine relates to conduct dating back to 2021 and does not take into account a compliance plan approved by ANPD in 2025, as well as additional safeguards introduced since then.

It added the measures comply with Brazil’s data protection law for both logged-in and logged-out users and will continue to engage with the regulator as it evaluates possible legal steps.

ANPD Director Coutinho told reporters that ByteDance had committed to implementing a plan aimed at bringing TikTok into compliance with Brazilian law.

According to Tuesday’s decision, ByteDance must delete the personal data of teenagers registered on the platform if the necessary parent, guardian, or other legal support arrangements are not provided and documented within 60 days.

The company faces fines of 137,081.49 reais per day if it fails to comply with the data-deletion, reporting, or notification requirements. The total fine, the regulator added, could be reduced by 25% if ByteDance waives its right to appeal and swiftly pays the penalty.
